name: Tiger

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one Bite attack against it as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tiger makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

description: Tigers are solitary, powerful ambush hunters whose sudden pounce can flatten prey before it ever gets a chance to flee.
